title: Cavitation Number Calculator
description: Calculate the Cavitation Number (Cavitation Parameter), a dimensionless number useful for analyzing fluid flow dynamics and predicting cavitation occurrence. The Cavitation Number represents the ratio of pressure difference to dynamic pressure.

components.content:
## Cavitation Number

The Cavitation Number (σ) is a dimensionless parameter used to analyze fluid flow dynamics and predict cavitation occurrence.

**Formula:**

σ = (pr - pv) / (1/2 × ρ × v²)

**Where:**
- σ = Cavitation number (dimensionless)
- pr = Reference pressure (Pa)
- pv = Vapor pressure of the fluid (Pa)
- ρ = Density of the fluid (kg/m³)
- v = Velocity of fluid (m/s)

**Note:** Lower Cavitation Numbers indicate higher risk of cavitation occurring in the system.
